_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Ant is current-catalog but frequently backordered/superseded in practice by the Butterfly; still on Bugaboo's US site. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Ant

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo® | Ant | Bugaboo® Ant adapter for car seats – Nuna/Cybex | 91510CS01

specs._unfoldedNote: Bugaboo lists open length 38.1–40.1 in (config-dependent), width 16 in, seat/canopy height ~37.4 in; adjustable handlebar 37.4–40.9 in.
specs._foldedNote: Ultra-compact fold ~9 (depth) × 14.9 × 21.6 in; fits most airline overhead bins.

brake.type: central push-down/lift-up foot pedal parking brake

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (0 mo) — reversible seat reclines lie-flat rear-facing for newborns; usable to ~4 yrs

specs._basketNote: Rear luggage basket rated 11 lb; separate underseat basket rated 6.6 lb.

safety.standards: Not published on Bugaboo's Ant spec page. Sold in the US, so it must meet the mandatory federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 (incorporates ASTM F833) to be marketed; EU units carry EN 1888. No explicit standard is printed by the manufacturer, so not asserted as certified.
safety.certifications: No JPMA or Greenguard certification is published for the Ant on the manufacturer or retailer pages reviewed.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat with lie-flat rear-facing recline; integrated wheel suspension; carry strap. Adapter-mounted infant car seats limited to 28.7 lb child weight.

specs.foldType: one-hand ultra-compact fold, self-standing, airline-cabin friendly
specs.recline: multi-position; lie-flat (near-flat) when rear-facing for newborn naps; two angles when forward-facing
specs.tires: rubber-coated foam wheels (not air-filled) with integrated suspension; front ~4.7 in, rear ~5.9 in diameter; front swivel

notes: Light/compact city stroller: ~15.8 lb, one-hand ultra-compact fold (~9 × 14.9 × 21.6 in) that fits overhead bins — a strong lightweight complement to the owned BOB Alterrain Pro (which covers jogging/all-terrain). Distinctive vs peers: the seat is genuinely reversible (rare in this compact class) and reclines lie-flat rear-facing, so it is newborn-suitable from birth without a bassinet. Best cited price $549 (Mega Babies) vs $678.95 Bugaboo DTC MSRP. STOCK: currently out of stock at both Bugaboo DTC and Mega Babies; the Ant is being phased out in favor of the Bugaboo Butterfly, so availability is spotty (open-box/other retailers like Albee Baby intermittently list it). Clek Liing attaches via the Bugaboo Ant 'Nuna/Cybex' adapter 91510CS01 (adapter-91510cs01). FOOTPRINT NOTE: although Clek's list files the Ant under a Nuna/Cybex adapter and the Liing is often described as a Maxi-Cosi-style seat, Bugaboo's OWN 91510CS01 product page explicitly lists 'Clek Liing' as compatible — so the manufacturer corroborates Clek's list; the Liing's stroller-mount interface matches the Nuna/Cybex bracket on this adapter (28.7 lb adapter weight limit). Bugaboo's official page does NOT list Maxi-Cosi (some third-party retailers add it) — see adapter fragment.
